prompt: As countries try to reduce their carbon emissions, some argue that nuclear power must be part of the solution, while others believe that only renewable sources such as wind and solar should be developed. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The climate change is one of the biggest problem in the world today, so all of the countries are trying to reduce the carbon emissions. Some experts believe that we need the nuclear energy, but the other experts think that we should use only the renewable energies like the wind and the solar. This essay will discuss the both opinions.

On the one hand, the nuclear power has the important benefits. It does not produce the carbon dioxide, so it does not make the global warming worse. Moreover, a nuclear station can produce a huge quantity of the electricity from a small quantity of the fuel, and it can work in the day and in the night. Therefore many countries can close their coal stations quickly if they build the nuclear stations. Moreover, a country which produces its own nuclear energy does not need to buy the gas from the other countries.

On the other hand, many people are afraid of the nuclear energy because of the accidents in the past. If an accident happen, the radiation can affect the people and the environment for the many years. In addition, nobody knows what we should do with the dangerous waste, which stay dangerous during the thousands of years. Therefore the people prefer the renewable energies, which are safe and clean.

In conclusion, the nuclear power is clean for the climate but dangerous for the safety, and the renewable energy is safe but it depends on the weather. In my opinion the governments should invest the money in the both of them.
title: Nuclear power in a low-carbon energy mix
